question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Fame
solution:
The correct answer is: **Shame**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Fame"** means the state of being known or talked about by many people, especially on account of notable achievements. (प्रसिद्धि)

 
 
• **Example:** She achieved **fame **through her groundbreaking research in physics.
 
 
 
• **"Shame"** refers to a painful feeling of humiliation or distress caused by the consciousness of wrong or foolish behavior. (शर्म)
 
 
• **Example:** He felt deep **shame **after being caught cheating in the exam.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'Fame'** is **'Shame'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Name** (नाम): A word or set of words by which a person or thing is known, addressed, or referred to.

 
 
• **Example:** His **name **is well-known in the field of medicine.
 
 
 
• **Scandal** (कांड): An action or event regarded as morally or legally wrong and causing general public outrage.
 
 
• **Example:** The politician was involved in a major financial **scandal**.
 
 
 
• **Stingy** (कंजूस): Unwilling to give or spend; ungenerous.
 
 
• **Example:** He is so **stingy **that he never donates to charity.
